notes.title: EMBR EXITS EARLY ACCESS ON SEPTEMBER 23RD!
notes.content:
Fill up those buckets. Unravel that hose. The next hot new co-op multiplayer is almost here.

Curve Digital and Muse Games are fired up to announce frenetic firefighting multiplayer Embr will exit Early Access on Steam on Thursday 23rd September 2021, little over a year after the game first entered the program.

As anyone who has taken on our Early Access version will know, Embr is a marvellously manic multiplayer where you and your friends come together to have a go at fighting ferocious fires and rescuing residents - if you count chucking them out of an open window onto the ground below as a bona fide rescue, that is. 

Players either take on the game solo or work together in online teams tackling fire after fire to pick up tips from clients, earning the ever-so-crucial 5-star rating in order to collect cash, upgrade tools, and hopefully become the ultimate ‘have-a-go hero’ firefighter. 

If one job wasn’t enough, players can also deliver takeout food on the fly with ‘Embr Eats’ and drop off explosive parcels as a ‘Box Box’ delivery expert, all before becoming a DIY safety engineer as a Gaslight Inc employee. It’s the full amateur adventurer experience!

On top of all the Embr’s standard gameplay, the full release will include:
[list]
[*]2 brand new expansive districts to explore housing 12 new hand-crafted levels.
[*]13 new tools and upgrades to customise your firefighting experience.
[*]5 brand new game modes to earn extra money your way.
[*]Daily and weekly missions for extensive replayability.
[*]Cross-platform play across PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Stadia.
[*]Extra difficulty settings and level mutators to keep things rolling.
[*]Tons of additional wearables, vehicle cosmetics, UI overhaul, achievements, and more.
[/list]
Check out our brand new release date trailer below!

[previewyoutube=hfAUUCk8Zqc;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062830/Embr/

notes.title: The District 3 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Respondrs! 

We are pleased to inform you that Embr has finally expanded to the Upper North Side, the wealthiest district in the city. For high networth and corporate clients whose cliffside mansions or high rises are burning down, Embr is now just a few taps away. Currently, Upper North Side brings 5 new neighborhoods, including a new showdown with ███████████████ Australian competition.

Give the new District a try and let us know your feedback by filling out this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeaGR2wFyY6Xh6ZEpxr5Mi-QAyUXFGwIl8z-2RRHIetqlvfPw/viewform?usp=sf_link]form![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/25aa1eb77ca9b4308fbe33851cfa8a1e50cb9315.gif[/img]

[b]New Content: [/b]

New Upper North Side district with 5 new levels

[u]Mystery Manors [/u]
Experience the grand clockwork centerpiece of this picturesque manor built and previously owned by a mystery novelist! 

[u]Yachtster Rent-A-Yacht[/u] 
Enjoy this scenic cruise along an artificially created glacial corridor right here in the city. Don’t forget to turn off the engine and enjoy the views!

[u]Crab and Go: Claw Club[/u] 
Only the most upscale diners are invited to the Claw Club. Redeem your spot in the rooftop ballpit by accumulating enough reward points at any Crab N Go location!

[u]Rockside Resort [/u]
All the fun of a mountain getaway, with none of the climbing! Get up to the amenities with our unique tramway, sponsored by BluStuff!

[u]Mysterious Signal from Embr HQ[/u]
Return to where it all began, and find out what’s going on at Embr HQ. Remember your training Respondr... 

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*] New: Co-default mission types! Some district 1 levels will start with a choice between rescue and another mission type for first time players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/54836b2dedef147f5a55f86b55a21ebdaba2c4cd.png[/img]
[*] Added: Steam Rich Presence
[*] Added: Discord Rich Presence
[*] Added: 13 new achievements!
[list][*] Your lobby basketball practice will finally pay off![/list]
[*] Added: In salvage missions, items that start outside, or are otherwise unrescuable will appear red.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/9ec0cd8a4979d2730cfda41e372a02334723edc1.png[/img]
[*] Added: Rescued and stolen items get a specific color tint to indicate if they are stolen or rescued.
[*] Adjusted difficulty in District 2 boss mission’s final room. Hard mode should be somewhat easier. Easy mode should be significantly easier.
[*] Default FOV changed to 75
[*] Default View Bob Reduction changed to 33[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Changes: [/b]
[list][*] Fixed: Clients not taking as much fall damage as they should
[*] Fixed: Ceiling bubble fire effects not vanishing when the fire is extinguished
[*] Fixed: Revived clients not counting as fed for Embr Eats if they had been fed before dying
[*] Fixed: Hair Dryer cooling mode not having any effect
[*] Change: Adjust rescue zone location for hard mode in Newton Ave 
[*] Fixed: Extended spool graphic not enabling when equipped
[*] Fixed: Various issues with doors not rendering correctly
[*] Fixed: Parachutes on physics props looking incorrect for non host players
[*] Fixed: Player getting stuck inside spawned car in lobby
[*] Updated: Credits
[*] Fixed: Various missing clothes renderers for players
[*] Fixed: Possibility that hose was less effective when running at low framerate with reduced physics quality setting enabled
[*] Fixed: Various missing or invisible geometry issues on levels
[*] Various other bug fixes and performance improvements[/list]

Thank you so much for your support, and enjoy District 3!

Don’t forget to [url=http://discord.gg/embr]join our Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/EmbrGame]follow us on Twitter[/url]!

For this month’s update, we’re focusing on your feedback and ideas to update the Embr app and your tools, the essentials for you to make more money. Going forward, we’ll also be focusing on squashing bugs, so keep the feedback and bug reports coming!

[list]
[*] $9,000 D 8 
[*] Years after this hydro jetpack prototype failed to pass all safety tests during US military trials, Embr corporation purchased the manufacturing rights to augment their fire safety personnel’s mission capabilities, although it takes additional water to use.
[/list]
[b][*] Quantum Sprinkler (Sprinkler)[/b]
[list][*] $12,000 G 10 D 7
[*] Previously thought to exist only at extremely small scales, our researchers were able to use quantum tunneling to allow water to spread through walls and at increased distances!
[/list]
[b][*] Handheld Jet Propulsion (Axe)[/b]
[list]
[*]$20,000 G 15 D 10
[*]Originally an experiment in using rocket miniaturization technology to add more force to an axe swing, attaching the rockets to the other end of the axe allowed our Respondrs to fly at high speeds during their swings!

[list]
[*]$10,000 G 10 D 7

notes.title: Embr Demolition Update out now
notes.content:
Greetings Respondrs! 

When you sign up with Embr, you can expect to make money, and it is our mission to help you do just that by ever expanding our products and services. This month, we are again proud to introduce a truck load of new and exciting additions to Embr. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/ccf51bed0957d2623326567f45da5d1ea6b2160a.gif[/img]

[b]New Game Mode -  Demolition:[/b]
Here at Embr, we’re always looking for new growth opportunities to pass on to our Respondrs! So we’re happy to announce Embr Demolition! Need to liquidate some capital tied up in real estate? Have some toxic assets you need dealt with? Hire an Embr Respondr! Using their expertise and experience with fire, Respondrs will quickly and cleanly demolish the building, leaving you with a fresh plot of land ready for new construction! Our Respondrs offer the fastest demolition times in the industry, thanks to a unique time based commission system. The faster it’s done, the more they get paid! So hire an Embr Respondr today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/9de1f1db877da48b7cff48bcf8a1b242668635a7.png[/img]

[b]Gold and Diamond Tier Rewards:[/b]
In addition to cold hard cash, Responders now have the opportunity to join the Embr rewards program and earn Gold and Diamond tier points. Use these points to unlock the most powerful upgrades and equipment. Gold and Diamond points now unlock certain valuable equipment. Earn Gold from special missions, and Diamonds for completing every special mission in a neighborhood! In the near future, be on the lookout for daily and weekly missions and challenges specifically designed for reward program members. Stay tuned! We’ll have more to unlock soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/77692e76bfc7966bbc4101413df097a57026ee75.gif[/img]

[b]New Tool - The Toilet Grenade ($500, 2 Gold): [/b]

For a long time Respondrs have been challenged by the problem of clients who just can’t contain their excitement about Embr’s amazing firefighting services. Many react in different, sometimes unpredictable ways. Now Embr has found a way to channel that energy into helping clients help themselves! Simply deploy the new Golden Toilet Grenade and all nearby clients will be attracted to it immediately! Be careful though, clients will prioritize the toilet over their own safety! Buy one now using Embr Gold!

[b]New Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ice Gun
[list]
[*] Refillable Ice ($1500, 3 Gold)[list]
[*] Refill at sinks, but be careful, it drinks up water quickly!
[/list]
[/list][list]
[*] Client Safety Insurance ($1000)
[list]
[*] Use the ice gun while carrying clients, just like you would a standard issue fire hose!
[/list]
[/list][*] Jump Pad
[list]
[*] Auto Cancel ($500)
[list]
[*] Tired of bouncing around uncontrollably? With the auto cancel upgrade, landing on a jump pad will allow you to fall softly.
[/list]
[/list]
[list][*] Rubberization Applicator ($500, 1 Gold)
[list]
[*] Launched objects will take significantly reduced damage upon landing after using the jump pad.
[/list]
[/list]
[list][*] Parachute Application ($2000, 1 Diamond)
[list]
[*] Applies a standard issue parachute to any object, client, or Respondr launched.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list][b]Balance Changes:[/b]
Clients in District 1 too often use construction materials that are a touch too flammable and electric outlets of generic brands, and this has made solo Respondr calls riskier.  We’ve worked with clients to better fireproof their premises so that Respondrs could make the same tips with ⅓ of the effort.
 
[list]
[*] New armor and respawn systems: Player more resistant to and heals faster from sudden hazard damages the first time through in a level. Player also receives extra spawns upon death for their first several missions. 
[*] Adjustments to fire spread and fire starts throughout District 1. 
[*] Adjustments to introduction, pacing, and placement of hazards, obstacles, and props throughout District 1. 
[*] Adjustments to total client count and minimum rescue success criteria in some District 1 levels as well as the Gaslight campaign. 
[*] Water levels have been adjusted. Be careful to manage your water and keep an eye out for sinks in missions.
[*] Various tool costs have been adjusted, many including new Gold and Diamond currencies.
[/list]
In addition, clients now notice you stealing their valuables in a new way. The more clients you currently have rescued, the more likely they are to notice you taking their things. If they notify you that they’re removing a star, you won’t get it back, but if they don’t tell you that, it means you will still receive your normal rating for the mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/f4961c16a4ec02902e632aa75e53e2c9a54f5903.jpg[/img]

[b]New Heads Up Display: [/b]
For Respondrs rushing into burning buildings, there’s arguably nothing more important than the HUD.  So it should come as no surprise that we’re introducing the Embr HUD 2.0! A lot of the things that Respondrs have been clamouring for to make the HUD easier to use and provide more information are now in. Enjoy!

notes.title: Embr’s festive Holiday Update out now
notes.content:
Holiday greetings, Responders!

Hot on the heels of our Winter Update last month, Embr’s Holiday update is out now on Steam! Here’s a full rundown of what you can expect...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/1abcb97605becf0235a45da4e2f6b67416019eec.gif[/img]

[h3]BoxBox Delivery and Cleanup Gig[/h3]

With the Holidays coming up, it’s the perfect time to earn a bit extra, and spend it right back in the Embr app! With the Holidays, clients are shopping online and shipping more than ever. We’ve partnered with BoxBox Delivery just in time to offer what our clients can’t have more of - boxes. 

With the new BoxBox Delivery and Cleanup campaign, you’ll be delivering boxes to your clients in the nick of time, and also clean up their box waste in the most explosive manner possible. Who needs to recycle boxes when we could just burn them up. It’s much faster. Beware though, while the BoxBox boxes are ultra lightweight, they are also highly flammable. So handle with care!

[h3]Vacuum Grenade[/h3]

The product lab at Embr has done it again! For this Holidays, we are introducing the next big thing in grenades for firefighting. The brand new vacuum grenade removes air and moisture directly from the environment, helping you smother fire, and cleanup excess water. Get it before it sells out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/92ed068a452458c93bfb2a970c100556ea141dcf.gif[/img]

[/list]

[*] Low is only recommended for below minimum spec players
[/list]
[b][Community Choice] Player Comfort:
[/b][/b][list]
[*] Added a Motion Sickness Crosshair option in Video Settings
[list]
[*] If you experience motion sickness, and increased FOV does not appear to help, please try this out in Video Settings
[*] Try and focus your vision at the middle of the crosshair while playing.
[/list]
[/list][h3]Embr Gear Drop: Holiday Outfits
[/h3]

Nothing pleases the eyes of your clients than the new Embr holidays fashion line. Earn more good will and tips, plus reach higher heights. Clients may be more generous with the stuff they leave behind as well.

notes.title: Embr's Sizzling Winter Update out now
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Respondrs!
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/2fdc0982b0dcbdd14f8776708bc1808cea9fac9e.gif[/img]

To warm up your bank accounts during winter, we’ve expanded to a new district! While we begin our phased rollout, your first new opportunities will be available at Newton Ave. The prospect of wintery weather has also inspired our R&D team, so we’re happy to unveil the revolutionary new Ice Acceleratr!  It’s rapid freezing technology can suppress fire, give you a foothold in dangerous situations, and protect clients and valuables when upgraded!

Plus, we’ve partnered with Appbulance to provide another new outfit to help your clients feel safe, and remind them of our 10% cross promotion with the premier app based medical ride share service!

Learn more in our brand new promotional video!

[previewyoutube=TO2aSM_d4Rc;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s a full rundown of what’s in today’s update.

[h3][b]New District 2 Neighborhood - Newton Ave [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/84b6cef6daea1900e6e9a0db8981269c2bd1398f.gif[/img]

Embr is expanding to a new and (more) upscale neighborhood, featuring rich(er) and corporate clients! Now is your opportunity to make more money, starting with Newton Ave. In District 2, you can expect a variety of security systems from Defendr™, who reached 100% market share due to its success in late night infomercials. In Newton Ave., you’ll get a first taste of upscale security with the keycard system.

[h3][b]The Ice Acceleratr[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/dbb3ae3a63a19433e8d6abf7a3f93e4611c93a95.gif[/img]

The revolutionary Ice Acceleratr might just be the most versatile firefighting gear we’ve ever engineered. The rapid freezing technology creates a protective shell of supercooled ice that is great for firefighting, creative scaling, and cooling clients down. Get yours before it sells out, and don’t forget to pickup some upgrades to be the coolest Respondr in town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/a42f7eb2da6e14d728eaff792602beb56669d72a.gif[/img]

notes.title: October Update: EmbrGigs™
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Respondrs![/h2]
Our October Update is here! In this update, we’re introducing a brand new mini-campaign with a trio of new levels, plus new features, balance improvements, and another truck load of bug fixes. Enjoy!

[h3]New EmbrGigs™ Mini-campaign[/h3]
Gaslight Inc has reported leaks all over the city. With the rollout of EmbrGigs, you can now take jobs with our corporate partners doing new and exciting jobs! Turn off gas lines, clear gas from buildings, and save clients in our new Mini-Campaign! Complete the 3 neighborhood campaign and you’ll receive a healthy profit, and a gift of the GasLight Leak Detection Helmet. Keep an eye out later this year for another EmbrGigs campaign as we expand into new corporate sponsorships.

[previewyoutube=RP0qmSEN4Zk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Gaslight Leak Detection Helmet[/h3]
What’s that? Smells like a gas leak! Never be caught off-guard again with the Gaslight™ Gasleak Detection Helmet!
Complete all 3 levels in the new EmbrGig™ to receive this new helmet!
[list][*] Sudden Gas Damage Taken +500%
[*] Gas Damage Taken -100%[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/f1f3f74b73494638166820a6de6eef09364ec37e.png[/img]

[h3]Parachute Upgrades [Community Choice][/h3]
You voted for your favourite parachute upgrades, so we’re making them happen. 
[list][*] More parachutes
[*] Faster descent
[*] Fulton Recovery System - Simply attach to a client and watch them be whisked away to safety.
[*] Irregular Object Attachments - Carry valuables to safety as well.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/152b9107db28fdad92da7c506983af0d6c435224.gif[/img]\

[h3]Mission Retry Button [Community Choice][/h3]
Client somehow not totally satisfied (not your fault of course), and you need a fresh start? No problem. With our new “Replay” button, you no longer need to return to the lobby before giving it another try. Saving you clicks so you can save clients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866337/3323631e46e30ceed039dea7d0819be5742128c8.png[/img]

[h3]Punching those NATs[/h3]
We've made more improvements to connection quality, especially with symmetric NATs. If you've been unable to connect to your friends so far because of symmetric NATs, this update should fix that, along with a number of connection related issues.

[h3]More new stuff:[/h3]
[list][*] We’ve pushed an update to your Embr Phone App! Roads now match the city’s layout 90% better!
[*] Maximum FOV increased to 95. Give it a try if you’re experiencing motion sickness or nausea while playing!
[*] New players should find level progression more varied.
[*] Bonus Cash has been added to Empire Towers. Seems those investments paid off!
[*] Early Access roadmap is now in-game! (View it in Settings > Extras).[/list]

[h3]Community Request Changes:[/h3]
[list][*] “No Skeletons” Toggle. Guaranteed to hide your mistakes.
[*] Grappler claws rotated so they aren't in the same place. How did that work before, anyway?[/list]

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list][*] Reduced fire spread speed multiplier in 2-4 player matches
[*] Hard Hat: Increased to -17% Explosive damage (from -10%)
[*] Cowboy Shirt: Increased to -25% Explosion damage (from -12%)[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list][*] Stadia build is still awaiting certification. If you’re looking to play with a friend on Stadia, please use the beta build: [b]stadiacrossplay[/b][/list]
[b]How to activate the stadiacrossplay branch in Embr:[/b]
[list][*]Right click "Embr" in your Steam Library and open Properties
[*]Click on the “Betas” tab and select the “stadia crossplay” build from the dropdown[/list]

Steam should start downloading this version of the game. Once it has finished, you will be able to launch Embr and play with your friends on Stadia! Please note that this build does not include the new EmbrGigs levels.

[h3]Achievement Ideas?[/h3]
[list][*] We’re looking to add new achievements in the next update. Let us know what achievements you’d like to see by [url=https://forms.gle/Vhcu3yNKeuwLRY95A]filling out this form[/url][/list]

notes.title: Addressing the Input Lag Issue
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Respondrs![/h3]

Today we’re bringing you Hotfix 1.12! Due to some changes in Unity, Vulkan has been causing input lag for a number of players. Because of this, and because we have been working on optimization with DX11 that addressed earlier graphical issues, we are deciding to switch the default launch setting back to DX11. 

This should resolve the input lag issue. If you prefer Vulkan or run into any issues with DX11, you can still switch to Vulkan via the launch dialog. Thanks for all your help diagnosing this problem and working with us to optimize for DX11! 

Now you can get back out there and feed those clients!


[h3]1.12 Hotfix: [/h3]
[list][*] Efforts towards fixing crashes + graphical issues in DX11.
[*] Made DX11 the default launch option. This should help mitigate input delay that a number of  players experienced. If you run into any issues with DX11 or prefer Vulkan, please select Vulkan at game start.[/list]

notes.title: New Feature & Update on Input Lag Issue
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Respondrs! [/h2]
We have a new feature and an update on the input lag issue that people have been reporting. 

[h1]Update on Input Lag Issue[/h1]
With the issue of input lag when running with Vulkan (the default game start option). This is looking like an issue that the game engine we used introduced in their latest update, and it is unfortunately affecting the game. We’re working to find a mitigation for this problem, but until then, here are a few workarounds that could help alleviate the issue:
[olist][*] Turn off Vsync in Video Settings in game. 
[*] Play the game in windowed mode
[*] Start and play the game with the “Play Embr (DX11)” start option[/olist]
Hope this helps! Thanks for your patience and really sorry for the issue everyone!

[h3]Steam Cloud Support[/h3]
We’re also happy to announce that Embr now supports Steam Cloud!

In order to create the Steam Cloud save file, please launch Embr on your computer and change a loadout to make it save (look for the “saving” icon in the lower right corner of the screen). That should have your save data saved on Steam Cloud!

If you encounter any issues with Steam Cloud or have any other issues, please feel free to email us at feedback@musegames.com anytime. 

Thanks so much again!

notes.title: First Alpha Test Complete!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We completed our first session of alpha testing! For this session, we invited a few members from our community to get a sneak peak and collect feedback from their first impressions. It’s been extremely valuable to start collecting feedback, and we’re looking to host more sessions with more people! 

[previewyoutube=NmObz5rQ9Y0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Here’s our very first Alpha Post-Mortem![/h1]

[b]The Setup:[/b]

[u]Run-through[/u]
We had our testers run through specific missions to look for how they managed pathing, level design, obstruction, puzzles, and rescue scenarios before moving on to the next missions. This way, we could get valuable, focused, and actionable feedback related to core level design, difficulty, intuitiveness, and replay. Levels built specifically to different hazards gave rise to opportunities to use specific tools, and wanted to see if players could come up with creative solutions.

[u]NAT Server Troubles[/u] 
We did a live multiplayer test, and we got multiplayer and Co-Op fully functioning for the Alpha (Hurray!). However, we had a couple server issues where sometimes the server would just drop and we weren't able to connect. This put a pause on a few of our tests, but we’ve since ironed this out so going forwards our Alpha tests will be much smoother.

[b]Learnings: [/b]

[u]Ease of Play[/u]
Without onboarding currently in the game, we were curious to see how new people pick up the game. This first session isn’t the most indicative as some of the people who tested were very active in the community, so they were already familiar with a lot of the concepts. They were able to pick up the game fairly naturally, allowing us to focus testing on more specific levels, situations, tools, and physics. We did see players struggling with tool selection and toggling at conventions though. In upcoming test sessions, how people manage the input scheme is definitely something we want to keep an eye on. 

[u]Lack of Character Limit[/u]
One small bug that had big repercussions was the lack of a character limit. We made the mistake of not adding a character limit to player name text field. This caused some players to crash as they exceeded character limit. This is a bug we’ll be fixing with the actual UI in place. 

[u]New Game Mode - Salvage[/u]

[previewyoutube=mQU4X75rTsQ;full][/previewyoutube]
In the test session, everyone wanted to haul stuff out of the burning houses and buildings, and we definitely took notice. It wasn’t just perceived valuable items either. People were having a lot of fun hauling burnt furniture, broken TV, and even trash out of the houses. It was… hilarious! So we took inspiration to spec out a new game mode code named Salvage. 

You’ll soon have the opportunity to haul out any valuable or junk to return to client, or make a bit of extra cash. Clients may assign valuables that they would pay extra for, and those may be priority rescues. 

[u]Electricity[/u]
One major issue we found is with the current presentation of electricity. When there’s a lot of fire, a player usually didn’t know where the electricity is coming from. We saw players just sprayed water, and all of a sudden there was electricity everywhere. In the test build, we did a bit to help players identity where the live wire was, but not the circuitry or the source. One of the effects update we are doing with electricity is to give players better visual cues as to how electricity travels and where it originates from. Here’s a peek at what we’re doing:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uoNqABX.gif[/img]

Once we have this in an upcoming test build, we’d love to see how players react. 

[u]Bug-to-Feature[/u]
We saw a case of someone jumping into a window or jumping down onto a trampoline, and then proceed to bounce sky high in the air. That was definitely a bug. But! People had so much fun with it that we’re turning that into a new tool, code named Launch Pad. Stay tuned! 

[u]Zany Bugs[/u]
Boobytrapped Floor: In Mission Papa, the floor in one of the rooms was missing, and it could cause players to snap and teleport. This one we caught and fixed. 
Missing Blue Zone: In Uniform, when playing multiplayer, sometimes the blue zone went missing, and people had to quit the mission and restart. 
Joke Text Stayed In: Sometimes in a mission, the joke text we left in dev build didn’t clean up, and it would remain on screen for the rest of the mission, sigh! 

[u]Time Zones[/u]
Because we started small we had a few issues getting everyone together at once to fill every slot for a testing session, we hope that we’ll have more than enough people in the Alpha to make sure everyone gets multiple chances to play with a full session next time.

We want to thank everyone once more for participating in this past weekend’s session!  
More Embr Alpha Testing is coming in roughly THREE WEEKS!! 
We’re getting a build ready to Steam as we speak to allow for smooth distribution and easy updates! As soon as that's ready we’re going live with alpha! 
To join an upcoming session and follow our progress, be sure to wishlist us: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062830/Embr/

And join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/G46NDhq]https://discord.gg/G46NDhq[/url]

We'll be getting some groups, pairing people up, and doing more organized testing sessions. You can also play Embr with us! We'll be in voice chat hanging out while we all test and gather feedback together!
[b]Get Hyped![/b]
